questions: The code change at line 438 removes the channel_index_for_rx lookup and directly uses t->chans[0].tx_id. Is it guaranteed that when poll_pid is set, t->chans[0] will always be valid? The BACKSTOP check at line 853 only validates t->chan_count for sched_mode, but poll mode (with poll_pid != 0) could also need channels.

The comment at line 435 states 'the scheduler outranks it whenever a mux set is active' but the code at line 372 now determines sched_mode based only on t->sched.count > 0, removing the poll_pid == 0 condition. How does this correctly handle the case where poll_pid is set but the scheduler still has channels?
